risk_if_not_implemented: Without Standardized Virtualization Formats, security may be bolted on rather than designed in, resulting in structural weaknesses that are costly to remediate and easy to exploit. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Concentration / Single-Point Dependency Failure (R-OR-2). No threat is rated Likely for this control; threats rated Possible include Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Configuration Management Program
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of configuration management controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Configuration Management Program (CFG-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Standardized Virtualization Formats (CLD-09) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Third-Party Management
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of third-party management controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Third-Party Management (TPM-02) provides third-party oversight that compensates for the absence of Standardized Virtualization Formats (CLD-09) by extending security obligations contractually and monitoring third-party risk in lieu of direct control. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
